summary: Dow -0.98%, Russell 2000 -0.76%, Nasdaq and S&P 500 ~-0.5%. UAE intercepted Iranian missiles activating missile alert system for first time since U.S.-Iran ceasefire. Iran warns U.S. forces away from Strait of Hormuz. WTI crude +4% to $106/bbl, Brent +5% to $114. Prior week (May 1) saw S&P 500 and Nasdaq record highs on Apple earnings.
